name: Double vitrage ancien
source: EN 673:2011; U-value 2.8 W/(m²·K) per EN ISO 10077-1
notes: Representative of old double glazing (pre-2000, air-filled, no low-e coating). U≈2.8 W/(m²·K) total including standard surface resistances (R_se=0.04, R_si=0.13 m²K/W). SHGC≈0.67. lambda/rho/cp are for the glass panes; use U-value directly for resistance calculations.
